Definition: Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jechezkel is the name of two Israelites, the head of the twentieth priestly course in the days of David, and the prophet Ezekiel, son of Buzi, to whom the word of the LORD came by the river Chebar. The course head and the prophet share the name, and the prophet's book carries it to the world.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God calls a priest to prophesy and a prophet to stand by the river, and the name Jehezekel covers both. My position is that the word of the LORD came expressly to Ezekiel, and it has not stopped coming.
